unchanged_algorithm: Original affine-chirp sketches and natural adjoint decoder, followed by ordinary real/imaginary coordinate medians.
guards: Input fixed independently of all seeds
One fixed nonzero a modulo M, or condition on one shared random nonzero a
Fresh independent uniform pairs (b,d) over all F_M x F_M, including d=0, independent across repeats

theorem.all_bin_failure: P(max_m |coordinate_median_j Xhat_j,m - X_m| > epsilon ||x||_1 / sqrt(N)) <= N (4 p_star)^(R/2)
theorem.sufficient_repeats: Any positive odd R >= 2 log(N/delta) / log(1/(4 p_star)), for 0 < delta < 1
theorem.alias_only: At m=qK: conditional variance [M||x||_2^2 - sum_r |F_r(qK)|^2]/N; Lambda=1 and M-bin union only on aliases, not all bins

cost.exact_scalar_work: O(R N log(2K)), including every sketch, per-repeat convolution, decoder preparation, and output
cost.median_comparisons: O(RN) ordered-real comparisons with deterministic linear selection; sorting instead costs O(N R log R)
cost.randomness: 2R independent uniform residue draws and optionally one shared nonzero-a draw; no RNG bit-cost theorem
cost.storage: O(RN) retained decoded outputs plus decoder workspace and input/final output; or O(RK+RM+M+K) auxiliary scalars with p-batching, plus input and N final outputs unless streamed

arithmetic: Exact complex roots and scalar arithmetic; ordered-real median comparisons are separate and are not supplied by an unordered field-operation contract.
not_claimed: finite-field concentration attribution to the original source
finite-bit complexity or exact comparison representation
fixed or nonuniform b or d extension
removal of the all-bin harmonic penalty
